////////WEB REPORT//////// ON JUNE 14,2006 @ 1921 HRS., A PARTY BOAT TIED TO THE OWNERS DOCK, CAUGHT FIRE. THE FIRE BURNT THE OWNER 60% OF HIS BODY, THE BOAT WAS DESTROYED. ACCORDING TO THE OWNER HE HAD JUST FILLED THE TWO TANKS ON THE BOAT APPROXIMATELY 90+ GALLONS. WHILE ATTEMPTING TO DO THE FIRE INVESTIGATION, WE FOUND THE GAS TANKS HAD NOT BEEN DAMAGED, BEFORE WE COULD FURTHER INSPECT THE TANKS, THE BOAT SANK. WE SAW A SHEEN AND SMELLED A ODOR OF FUEL COMING FROM THE HULL. WE CONTACTED THE POLICE DEPT, WHO HAS JURISDICTION OVER THE WATER WAYS. THE CORPORAL STATED THAT IT WAS THE OWNER'S RESPONISIBLITY FOR CLEAN UP. I TOLD HIM THAT THE OWNER WAS CRITICALLY INJURY AND WAS FLOWN TO LAS VEGAS BURN CENTER. BEFORE LEAVING THE SITE, WE INFORMED THE NEIGHBORS ABOUT THE SPILL. I SUBMITTED A REPORT TO THE STATE OF ARIZONA. I WAS CONTACTED BY THE DAN ROE AND SUGGESTED THAT WE REPORT THIS TO YOU. WHEN THE BOAT WAS REMOVED FROM THE WATER THE TANKS WERE EMPTY.

THE CORPORAL STATED THAT IT WAS THE OWNER'S RESPONISIBLITY FOR CLEAN UP. I TOLD HIM THAT THE OWNER WAS CRITICALLY INJURY AND WAS FLOWN TO LAS VEGAS BURN CENTER. BEFORE LEAVING THE SITE, WE INFORMED THE NEIGHBORS ABOUT THE SPILL. I SUBMITTED A REPORT TO THE STATE OF ARIZONA. I WAS CONTACTED BY THE DAN ROE AND SUGGESTED THAT WE REPORT THIS TO YOU. WHEN THE BOAT WAS REMOVED FROM THE WATER THE TANKS WERE EMPTY.

INCIDENT DETAILS: • A LARGE GAS LINE EXPLOSION RESULTED IN TWO LARGE FIRES AND VISIBLE SMOKE PLUMES. • THE CAUSE OF THE EXPLOSION IS UNDER INVESTIGATION; AUTHORITIES DO NOT SUSPECT CRIMINAL ACTIVITY. LOCAL, STATE, AND FEDERAL RESPONSE: • THE LOCAL PINE COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE REPORTS THE GAS HAS BEEN TURNED OFF, AND THERE IS NO ONGOING DANGER TO THE PUBLIC. • SEVERAL LOCAL FIRE DEPARTMENTS, EMS, AND LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES WERE DISPATCHED TO THE SCENE. • EVACUATIONS WERE ORDERED FOR RESIDENTS NEAR THE EXPLOSION. • NORTHERN NATURAL GAS AND EMERGENCY RESPONDERS REMAIN ON-SITE TO MANAGE THE SITUATION AND INVESTIGATE THE CAUSE. • NO INJURIES HAVE BEEN REPORTED. FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION, REFER TO THE DHS COMMON OPERATING PICTURE AND THE HOMELAND SECURITY INFORMATION NETWORK.

THE ANOMALY EXTENDED WESTWARD FROM THE SOURCE BEFORE IT TURNED TOWARDS THE NORTH. OVERALL, IT MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 6.1 NM AND WAS 0.5 NM AT ITS WIDEST POINT. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE OUT OF THE NE AT 7 KTS.

properties.content:

Medium Affected: SOIL

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 32.844462, -104.400455 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 25200 gallons
Report Description
DRESSER SLEEVE ON PRODUCED WATER PIPELINE CRACKED AND RELEASED APPROXIMATELY 600 BBLS OF PRODUCED WATER WITH HYDROCARBON CONSTITUENTS INTO RIO PENASCO DRAW. THE DRAW IS A DRY STREAM BED AND IS CLASSIFIED AS AN EPHEMERAL STREAM. VACUUM TRUCKS WERE DISPATCHED IMMEDIATELY TO RETRIEVE ALL STANDING FLUID. 460 BBLS WERE RECOVERED. A BACKHOE WAS ALSO DISPATCHED TO SCRAPE THE SURFACE. NEW MEXICO OCD WAS NOTIFIED. DUE TO CONDITION OF THE STREAM AND SEVERE DROUGHT CONDITIONS SE NEW MEXICO IS EXPERIENCING THE RELEASE WAS CLASSIFIED AS A NON-EMERGENCY. AS PER EPA WEBPAGE DIRECTIONS NON-EMERGENCY RELEASES WERE TO BE REPORTED TO REGIONAL OFFICE AND THEREFORE IT WAS NOT IMMEDIATELY REPORTED TO NRC. EPA REGION 6 OFFICE WAS NOTIFIED TUESDAY MORNING, DUE TO THE MLK HOLIDAY. EPA REGION 6 DUTY OFFICER DIRECTED REPORTING PARTY TO FILE A REPORT WITH NRC. REMEDIAL ACTIONS ARE STILL BEING PURSED IN ACCORDANCE WITH STATE GUIDELINES.
